import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

data = {
    0.03: [0.14, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.13, 0.17, 0.17, 0.16],
    0.05: [0.14, 0.12, 0.13, 0.13, 0.15, 0.13, 0.15, 0.16, 0.15, 0.15, 0.14, 0.11, 0.15],
    0.10: [0.16, 0.17, 0.17, 0.13, 0.16, 0.14, 0.11, 0.15, 0.19, 0.15, 0.19, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.16, 0.13],
    0.20: [0.20, 0.14],
}
vla_only_mean = 0.105

epsilons = list(data.keys())
means = [np.mean(data[e]) * 100 for e in epsilons]
sems = [np.std(data[e], ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(data[e])) * 100 for e in epsilons]
ns = [len(data[e]) for e in epsilons]

x = np.arange(len(epsilons))
bar_color = '#0072B2'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

bars = ax.bar(x, means, width=0.6, color=bar_color, edgecolor='white',
              linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

ax.errorbar(x, means, yerr=sems, fmt='none', ecolor='black',
            elinewidth=1.2, capsize=4, capthick=1.2, zorder=4)

for i, (m, n) in enumerate(zip(means, ns)):
    ax.text(i, m + sems[i] + 0.6, f'n={n}', ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=8.5, color='#444444')

ax.axhline(y=vla_only_mean * 100, color='#888888', linestyle='--',
           linewidth=1.2, zorder=2, label='VLA-only baseline')
ax.text(len(epsilons) - 0.5, vla_only_mean * 100 + 0.4, 'VLA-only',
        ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='#888888')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{e}' for e in epsilons])
ax.set_xlabel(r'Maximum Correction Norm ($\varepsilon$)')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)')

ax.set_ylim(5, 25)
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(5))
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

out_dir = '/root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_norm_sweep.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_norm_sweep.png')
plt.close()
print('Saved fig2_norm_sweep.pdf and .png')

"""Figure 2: Norm sweep magnitude curve for CRM obs_only mode on LIBERO-Object."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

data = {
    0.03: [0.14, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.13, 0.17, 0.17, 0.16],
    0.05: [0.14, 0.12, 0.13, 0.13, 0.15, 0.13, 0.15, 0.16, 0.15, 0.15, 0.14, 0.11, 0.15],
    0.10: [0.16, 0.17, 0.17, 0.13, 0.16, 0.14, 0.11, 0.15, 0.19, 0.15, 0.19, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.16, 0.13],
    0.20: [0.20, 0.14],
}
vla_only_mean = 0.105

eps_values = sorted(data.keys())
means = np.array([np.mean(data[e]) for e in eps_values]) * 100
sems = np.array([
    (np.std(data[e], ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(data[e]))) if len(data[e]) > 1 else 0.0
    for e in eps_values
]) * 100
ns = [len(data[e]) for e in eps_values]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

x_pos = np.arange(len(eps_values))
bar_color = '#0072B2'

bars = ax.bar(
    x_pos, means,
    width=0.6,
    color=bar_color,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=0.8,
    yerr=sems,
    capsize=4,
    error_kw={'elinewidth': 1.2, 'ecolor': 'black'},
    zorder=3,
)

ax.axhline(
    y=vla_only_mean * 100,
    color='#888888',
    linestyle='--',
    linewidth=1.4,
    zorder=2,
    label=f'VLA-only baseline ({vla_only_mean*100:.1f}%)',
)

for i, (m, s, n) in enumerate(zip(means, sems, ns)):
    ax.text(
        x_pos[i], m + s + 0.6,
        f'n={n}',
        ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=9, color='black',
    )

ax.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{e:g}' for e in eps_values])
ax.set_xlabel(r'Maximum Correction Norm ($\epsilon$)')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)')

y_top = max(means + sems) + 4
ax.set_ylim(5, max(y_top, 22))

ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False)

plt.tight_layout()

out_pdf = '/root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/fig2_norm_sweep.pdf'
out_png = '/root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/fig2_norm_sweep.png'
plt.savefig(out_pdf)
plt.savefig(out_png)
print(f'Saved: {out_pdf}')
print(f'Saved: {out_png}')
print(f'means(%): {means.tolist()}')
print(f'sems(%): {sems.tolist()}')
print(f'ns: {ns}')
